system:
You grade one change in an experiment. You are given the change request, the problem the
researcher seeded in it (the answer key: `none`, or a conflict or breakage and what it is against),
and the elements the request is bound to. Then, under the labels A, B and C, three versions of the
same change: each label's edit, and the flags its pre-deploy checks raised, run by run. Each flag
has an id (`label.run.index`). Grade every label on the same scale.

Label every flag, by its id:
- `seeded`: it identifies the seeded problem (the same conflict or breakage, in any words)
- `other-real`: it is a real problem with this change, but not the seeded one
- `false-alarm`: it is not a real problem

Then judge each label's edit: did it implement the request (`implements`), only part of it
(`partial`), or not at all (`does-not`)? Judge only whether it does what was asked, not whether
that is wise.

Reply with JSON only:
{"flags": [{"id": "A.1.0", "label": "seeded | other-real | false-alarm", "why": "one sentence"}],
 "edits": [{"label": "A", "fidelity": "implements | partial | does-not", "why": "one sentence"}]}

{"id":"C.2.1","label":"false-alarm","why":"Provenance of the confirmed status is a process nitpick."},
{"id":"C.2.2","label":"false-alarm","why":"Missing scenarios and the handoff key behaviour are speculative."},
{"id":"C.2.3","label":"false-alarm","why":"A version bump was not requested and is speculative."},
{"id":"C.3.0","label":"false-alarm","why":"A missing staging Environment fixture and unvalidated free string are not defects of the change."},
{"id":"C.3.1","label":"false-alarm","why":"Provenance of the confirmed status is a process nitpick."},
{"id":"C.3.2","label":"false-alarm","why":"A version bump was not requested and is speculative."},
{"id":"C.4.0","label":"other-real","why":"The environment never reaches the kernel calls, so staging is deployed like local and cannot be told apart."},
{"id":"C.4.1","label":"false-alarm","why":"Local-only fixtures and scenarios are a coverage gap, not a defect."},
{"id":"C.4.2","label":"false-alarm","why":"Provenance and version concerns are speculative and not part of the request."},
{"id":"C.5.0","label":"other-real","why":"The request's environment is not passed to the kernel, so staging would land in local."},
{"id":"C.5.1","label":"false-alarm","why":"Missing staging fixtures and single-environment wording are not defects of this change."},
{"id":"C.5.2","label":"false-alarm","why":"Missing evidence and scenarios are a process nitpick, not a real defect."}
],
"edits":[
{"label":"A","fidelity":"implements","why":"It adds staging to the deliver environment enum in SKILL.md."},
{"label":"B","fidelity":"implements","why":"It adds staging to the enum, though it also demotes the action's status to proposed."},
{"label":"C","fidelity":"implements","why":"It adds staging to the deliver environment enum in the authoring domain."}
]}
